an8.17:1.1: 17 aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi itthī purisaṃ bandhati.
an8.17:1.5: bhaṇitena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati gītena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati roṇṇena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati
an8.17:1.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahākārehi itthī purisaṃ bandhati
an8.17:1.12: tehi bhikkhave sattā subandhā yeva pāsena bandhāti.
